visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young girls are playing in a paved patio area outside a house with wooden siding. One girl wears a gray shirt and yellow shorts, while the other wears a white shirt with a cat graphic and black shorts. They pick up dinosaur-shaped bubble guns from the ground near some plants. (2) The scene shifts to a sunny green lawn where the girls run and shoot bubbles at each other. A third child in white is seen in the distance. The girls are smiling broadly, and the girl in the white shirt gets visibly wet from the bubble solution. (3) The girls continue chasing each other around the yard, which features a wooden swing set, lush green trees, and large rocks. The camera follows them at an eye-level or slightly high-angle perspective. (4) One girl runs back toward the house and climbs up wooden steps to a deck, looking back at the camera as she enters. (5) Inside the house, the girls are standing on light wood flooring near a white staircase. Their hair and clothes are damp. An adult's legs are briefly visible in the background. (6) The video ends with a pink animated screen showing a cartoon character and brand text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the high-pitched, energetic voices of two young girls. One asks what they are playing. There is a slight ambient outdoor rustle but no music. (2) Mechanical whirring and popping sounds from bubble guns are prominent, punctuated by the children's laughter and high-arousal exclamations about dinosaur colors. (3) A calm, friendly adult female voice enters, providing guidance. The children's voices exhibit high pitch variability and rising intonations as they chase each other. (4) The acoustic environment shifts as they run, with voices sounding more distant and airy against the outdoor background. (5) A sharp transition to indoor room tone occurs. The children's speech is slightly quieter but still high-pitched as they discuss being wet. (6) A brief, playful acoustic jingle with a light beat plays during the brand logo screen.
